# boringssl / bn_div

boringssl's own fuzz target `bn_div` ([source](source/bn_div.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over boringssl (boringssl.googlesource.com/boringssl at a074f282).

Checks 3 properties (listed below); the first, an algebraic law: Division law: after BN_div(q, r, n, d), checks q*d + r == n exactly (BN_mul, BN_add, BN_cmp).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against boringssl at commit a074f282 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- BN_div on a non-zero divisor must succeed ([lines 59-60](source/bn_div.cc#L59-L60)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.
- Remainder bound |r| < |d| (BN_ucmp) ([line 61](source/bn_div.cc#L61)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.
- Division law: after BN_div(q, r, n, d), checks q*d + r == n exactly (BN_mul, BN_add, BN_cmp) ([lines 63-66](source/bn_div.cc#L63-L66)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies them on every input it covers.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch boringssl` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
